entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Treasure!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hrm!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: THIS is the Treasure!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Get back!

entries.speaker: Familiar Voice
entries.en: Meddlesome vermin.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Is this what you're looking for?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How dare you try to trap me like[n]some kind of mouse!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So you had a fake prepped, huh!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Counterfeits are accepted in the world[n]of Japanese art.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What made you change like this!?[n]Is it because you became famous!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Can't you understand how much it[n]pains me to inquire about the crimes[n]of my foster father!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: ...Now that I think back, the only reason[n]why I took you in was due to my ties[n]with your mother.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: That woman never lost her passion for[n]painting even after her husband died.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Her skills and talents were quite[n]astonishing... That's why I decided[n]to look after her.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Your mother and the artwork she[n]created—they're all MY works of art!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How low can you sink?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: I suppose I can grant you a gift before[n]you die—a glimpse of the genuine[n]"Sayuri"!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Genuine...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's... the real "Sayuri"?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This can't be!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Mom...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Indeed it is. This was painted by your[n]mother. It's a portrait of herself.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: A woman who knew her death was[n]coming painted her last wishes, for[n]the son she would leave behind.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: That is the truth behind the mystery[n]of "Sayuri"'s expression!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You stole something THAT personal!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: I knew at first glance.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: I knew it'd be a huge success if I added[n]a touch to the painting and announced it[n]under my name!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But the baby in the picture...[n]Why did you paint over it?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: ...It was all to stage it.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: If the babe is erased, the reason for[n]the woman's expression will become[n]a mystery!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: That is what the general public is[n]drawn to! Each of those parasitic[n]critics wrote the same thing!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I always felt something was off about[n]all this... Now I know what it is.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If you really treasured that painting,[n]you wouldn't even think about[n]replicating it for profit!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You don't love art at all!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Though you have a real Treasure,[n]your true skills are nothing more[n]than those scribbles on that fake!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It makes me laugh, asshole!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: So you'll defy me no matter what...

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Well then, since you're my work of art,[n]Yusuke, I'm going to reap you for[n]the sake of my future.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: ...Along with those insolent friends[n]of yours there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can't believe you're treating both[n]mother and son like they're objects...[n]You're inhuman!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Fox?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I've heard that you destroy your "art"[n]once they outlive their usefulness...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Did that include my mother as well?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: She just so happened to have a seizure[n]in front of me. That's when a thought[n]crossed my mind...

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: If I don't call for help and leave her be,[n]I could obtain her painting without[n]any strings attached.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No... You let her die!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: She was physically weak. No one would[n]doubt if she just dropped dead because[n]of a seizure.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Above all, Yusuke, didn't you think it was[n]odd that I discovered your talent when[n]you were only three?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: The reason why I kept you around was[n]to keep you from realizing the truth[n]behind "Sayuri."

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You killed her...!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: The artistic talents you inherited from[n]your mother were a delightful[n]miscalculation, though.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: If I'm to steal ideas, it's much easier[n]robbing the future of brats who won't[n]talk back than adults.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: It's thanks to you that I came up with[n]the idea. You have my gratitude.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: *chuckle*

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I thank you, Madarame!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Every reason for me to forgive you[n]has disappeared without a trace[n]at this very moment!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You aren't some rotten artist...[n]You're a despicable fiend who[n]wears the skin of an artist!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: All you good-for-nothings...! Barging[n]into my museum and doing whatever[n]the hell you want...

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Those who have the connections[n]make the rules; those who don't,[n]follow them.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Not to mention, the value of art is all[n]subjective! I make the rules in the art[n]scene!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: I am the supreme being! I am the god[n]of the art world!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This isn't good. Get back!
